usage.callShape: GET https://transit.agentic-jp.com/stations/search?q=Shinjuku (query param `q` is required, min 2 chars; accepts kanji/kana/romaji)
usage.outputShape: body.results[] each has {station_id, name_ja, name_en, name_kana, operator_ids[], line_ids[], lat, lng}; also body.query and body.count
quirks: Registry inputSchema is null. The required query param is `q` (NOT `query` or `search`) — discovered only inside the base64 payment-required header's bazaar extension.
`q` must be at least 2 chars; accepts kanji (新宿), kana, or romaji (Shinjuku), and tolerates the 駅/station suffix.
Some results have lat/lng = null (e.g. Seibu-Shinjuku); don't assume coordinates are always present.
usage.guide: Call GET https://transit.agentic-jp.com/stations/search with a single query param `q` set to the station name (romaji like "Shinjuku", kana, or kanji; min 2 chars). x402 micropayment of $0.001 USDC on Base settles automatically. Read the matched stations from body.results[], using station_id as the canonical id and operator_ids[]/line_ids[] to know which lines serve it. body.count is the number of matches. Use this to resolve a fuzzy station name to a canonical record before any follow-on transit lookups.
